title: FizzBuzz for one number
prompt: If n is divisible by both 3 and 5 return "FizzBuzz". If only by 3 return "Fizz". If only by 5 return "Buzz". Otherwise return the number itself as text, e.g. "7".
starter:
func solve(n: int) -> String:
	return str(n)
hint: Check the "both" case first (`n % 15 == 0`), or the later checks will steal it. `str(n)` turns a number into text.
